territorial_scope.description: Applies within the State of Maryland, with the program housed in the Maryland Department of Labor and grants available to state residents.

evidence.quote: THERE IS A TALENT INNOVATION PROGRAM IN THE DEPARTMENT.

summary.short: Establishes a Talent Innovation Program in the Maryland Department of Labor to fund job training in priority sectors, including artificial intelligence, and creates the Talent Innovation Fund as a nonlapsing special fund. Takes effect July 1, 2024.
summary.long: Adds Subtitle 16 (§§ 11–1601 to 11–1604) to the Labor and Employment Article, establishing a Talent Innovation Program in the Maryland Department of Labor to increase access to high-quality job training in priority sectors including cybersecurity, health care, biotechnology, manufacturing and artificial intelligence. The Division of Workforce Development and Adult Learning and the Governor's Workforce Development Board jointly administer the program, which may conduct pilots, convene stakeholders and conduct research, and must establish an initial cybersecurity pilot expanding regional cyber ranges. It creates the Talent Innovation Fund, a special nonlapsing fund held by the Treasurer and funded by state budget appropriations, grants, donations, interest earnings and other accepted money. The Department may use the fund for grants to listed entities and state residents, matching funds, program financing and administrative costs, and expenditures are made only in accordance with the state budget. Interest earnings are credited to the fund. The Department may adopt regulations and must report annually on or before January 1, beginning in 2025. The act amends State Finance and Procurement § 6–226(a)(2) so that the Talent Innovation Fund is excluded from the rule directing net interest on special funds to the General Fund. The act takes effect July 1, 2024. The text sets out no penalties.
